title: reaction
description: One person's reaction or vote on a post, for a source that names who reacted. See contracts/reaction.md.

id.description: lowercase hex sha256 of the word reaction, source, target, kind and author, each followed by a newline except the last

channel.description: where the reaction was given; the target post's channel

target.description: the id of the post reacted to

kind.description: the reaction as the source names it, such as +1, heart or upvote

author.description: the salted hash of who reacted, made as a post's author is

said_at.description: when the reaction was given; null when the source does not say

fetched_at.description: when the response it came from was received, read from the kept response

private.description: true when it came from a private stream the owner consented to

raw_ref.description: where the raw response it came from is kept, relative to the store
